            void thread_pool_destroy (thread_pool_t * pool)
          

          

            Destroy a thread pool. Stops all threads (if not already stopped),
            waits for them to exit, and frees all pool resources. It's safe to
            call this even if threads are still running - they will be stopped
            first.
          

          

          
Parameters

          

            pool Thread pool to destroy (NULL is safe, does nothing)
